last.verdict: Shares rose as Royal Caribbean beat estimates, raised its yearly profit forecast, and 2027 bookings looked strong.

reasons.label: Raised profit forecast
reasons.text: Full-year adjusted earnings per share forecast raised to $17.85–$17.95 after a $6.57 third quarter.

reasons.label: Strong 2027 bookings
reasons.text: 2027 bookings are up in the high teens, and booking volumes rose in the mid-teens.

reasons.label: Beat on demand, costs
reasons.text: Late bookings beat guidance, and some costs shifted into Q4, which flattered Q3.

story: In July, Royal Caribbean beat estimates and raised its yearly forecast, though war-related booking weakness weighed and the stock dipped early. Shares later hit a one-year low in September. October's beat and another raise, with firm 2027 bookings, drew a rebound.
